events.body:
## Context

README points to `.github/workflows/flutter-tests.yml` (doesn't exist), lists `lib/widgets/` (doesn't exist), uses the deprecated `flutter pub run`, and says `flutter run` although there are no platform folders.

## What to do

1. Point the CI section at `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, fix the tree to match `lib/`, use `dart run`, and add `flutter create .` before `flutter run`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every path in the README exists
- [ ] Setup steps work from a clean checkout

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the README.
```
